deviations.what: the first launch of the matrix aborted 2395 times without ever starting a worker

defects.detail: scripts/r3a2/trial.mjs imported `MODEL_ROUTES` from ./models.mjs, which exports `MODEL_ROUTES_SENTINEL`; every launch died at module link time
defects.fix: the import and both its uses now name MODEL_ROUTES_SENTINEL

defects.detail: the retry loop condition was `validByPair.size === 0 || attemptsHere < MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_PAIR`, which for the first pair is always true and spun without limit
defects.fix: the loop is now bounded by its own per-run counter alone

deviations.nqImpact: NONE — no worker process and no model session was created by any aborted launch, so no trial record and no Nq contribution came from them
deviations.evidence: the run directory held no trial.json, no worker transcript and no session artifact after the aborted launch
deviations.immutabilityImpact: NONE — both fixes were made before primary trial 1, so the engine-immutability clause was never engaged

deviations.when: before the frozen matrix, after the plan commit
deviations.what: one F-C x deepseek-flash run was executed directly to verify the harness end to end before committing the 20-run budget
deviations.note: the run scored 6/6 classes, which is the same ceiling the four scheduled F-C/F-D pairs reached; it is recorded as a deviation and not as evidence of anything
every digested artifact is byte-identical to the plan the runs were executed against

lawsApplied.portfolioQualificationNotBridgeHunting: the four new pairs were qualified whatever their outcome; no fixture was revised to move a verdict
lawsApplied.noFixtureAuthoredAfterFirstRun: no fixture was authored or revised after primary trial 1
lawsApplied.historicalVerdictsUnchanged: the R3-A0/R3-AE verdicts were carried forward from the committed record and not rerun
